issues.title: Truncated Context / Missing Subfolder Content
issues.why: The spec exceeds the 136KB cap, causing the Go Binary Release Pipeline (02-release-pipeline.md) and other subfolder files to be cut off mid-sentence.
issues.fix: Split the module into smaller, independent spec files or increase the context window for the auditor.

issues.title: Archetype GWT Stubs
issues.why: AC-13 explicitly admits that subfolder archetypes (Browser/Go) currently only have structural-floor ACs and lack runtime behavior GWTs.
issues.fix: Add specific GWT criteria for source-map removal, cross-compile matrix verification, and checksum integrity.

issues.title: Unresolved External Linter Dependencies
issues.why: AC-11 references linter scripts in spec/27-spec-toolchain/ which are not provided in the current context.
issues.fix: Include the relevant sections of spec/27 or provide the script CLI signatures in the shared conventions.
